user.title: Connect to Family Finance
user.description: Enter the URL of your Family Finance app (e.g. the add-on ingress URL or http://host:8099) and the household to link.

data.token: App service token (required for protected deployments)

reauth_confirm.title: Update Family Finance service token
reauth_confirm.description: The app rejected this connection. Enter its current service token; the household and app URL stay unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Family Finance app

abort.already_configured: This household connection is already configured

trigger_type.goal_milestone: A savings goal milestone was reached

init.title: Per-item financial sensors
init.description: Optional: expose selected bill, account and goal names and numeric values to Home Assistant entities, recorder and automations. None keeps item details disabled. All and Selected share the entity cap (maximum 100).

error.too_many_entities: The chosen items exceed the entity cap. Reduce the selection or increase the cap.
